supersedes.scope: Python scope only: replaces permission for application components. Prior record and all historical outcomes remain unchanged. Current README files intentionally advance beyond its historical documentation pins.

boundary.location: External tooling only; Python/C shims remain external too.
boundary.deferredPurpose: Potential Core AI/macOS 27 preparation only, if needed and separately approved; not current macOS 26 build/test work.

requiredApprovalRequest: Exact purpose, interpreter/tool/shim versions and content identities, source bytes, fixed invocation, actual host OS/SDK.
Exact read-only input set, versioned output schema, disjoint output/work roots, and import/environment configuration.
Filesystem, process, network, cache/temp, import/environment and resource effects: allowed operations, enforced restrictions, monitoring mechanism and coverage limits for each.
Finite work/resource limits, owner-visible cancellation and shutdown behavior; no indefinite waiting obligation or signals to unrelated processes.
Artifact retention and disposal plan; disposable does not mean automatic cleanup or erasure of evidence.

sideEffects.required: Bound and monitor every relevant side-effect class before launch approval.
sideEffects.unobservableEffects: Report the gap and do not launch; monitoring must not be silently treated as confinement.
sideEffects.resources: Capture start/end and declared wall/CPU/memory measures; physical energy only if actually measured with qualifications.
sideEffects.unexpectedEffects: Do not admit outputs; follow only the separately approved bounded cancellation/retention plan.

dataInterface.shape: Bounded versioned artifacts with pinned input/output identities; no executable commands or live capability transfer.
dataInterface.admission: Independent native validation of structure, bounds, content identity and task-specific predicates; Python output is a proposal, never sole authority.
dataInterface.promotion: No direct writes to canonical authoritative state.
